slots.title: Privacy Policy: header spot
where: /privacy → components/legal/legal-page.tsx header, right of the title and intro; hidden on phones
slots.css: 176×176, vertically centred beside the header text
slots.crop: Object centred, three-quarter view, ~80% of the square with even padding.
slots.lighting: neutral, soft top-left key, one crisp white highlight
slots.fallback: Soft blue radial glow with halftone dots, same size.
slots.brief: A chunky padlock fused with a small retro CRT terminal: the screen shows abstract blue bar-chart glyphs (no letters or numbers) and the keyhole glows hololive blue (#3fb8f5). A few halftone dots and thin hairline sparkles around it. Clean flat vector shapes, blue key colour, deep ink-navy (#0a0c11) shading and outline, one crisp white highlight.
slots.notes: Shown on dark and light page backgrounds: bold silhouette with a dark outline, few details, no text. Pair with legal-terms-spot (same framing and rendering).
